title: Acquire the local graph law before transferring the connector proof
statement: The actual graph module earns profile/occupation/reset laws from a fixed irreducible conversion graph, then the seven-source corrected transfer tolerates any fixed positive decay exponent using K=log^2(2+r), actual-output bounds and a physical-clock polynomial-weight construction. Both seeds2a->a+D and2a->2D and positive reverse2D->a+D are required for the GLOBAL closed-class conclusion, although the local reset theorem has broader seed scope. Only a-parent linear birth is admitted. Dormant hidden types are frozen at D=0, allowing exact transfer of the phase foundations while positive-D graph laws are acquired anew. The false O(1/M) first-arrival clock is not imported. Constants depend on the fixed graph/rates; this is not a general weakly-reversible recurrence algorithm.
